parameters.prompt: A precise looping 9-pose hand-drawn chibi sticker: a performer turns, loses her red beret, catches it, and converts the accident into a graceful hat bow. ONE girl: Xingtong red-beret everyday costume. Silver-gray side-swept bob, single curved cowlick, big deep blue eyes with flat upper lashes and blue reflected light, round peach blush, wide cheerful face, dark red sleeveless pinafore over white blouse. ONE RED BERET, even when it is off her head. Fixed waist-up 3/4 camera, off-center to the left so the hat can fall at screen RIGHT. Solid pure opaque white background. Contemporary Japanese/Chinese hand-drawn sticker illustration, dark plum variable ink, silver hair with bright clean cel highlights. Clear silhouettes, no on-screen text, no motion lines or ghosting. Each frame is a complete drawing, STRICT continuity. 1 She wears the single red beret, torso turned away in anticipation. 2 She swings around and smiles to the audience with stage flair. 3 The red beret begins to slip off her hair at the right while her EYES move sideways to follow it and hands stay low. 4 The ONLY beret is visibly detached and falls right, bare silver head, she leans after it, one hand reaches. 5 That same single hand CATCHES the beret from below, far away from her bare head. A little startled look, freeze on the catch. 6 She straightens, bringing the caught red beret against her chest, regains a confident smile. 7 She performs a theatrical deep bow over the beret in that same hand, graceful curved body outline. 8 She rises and lifts beret back onto head with the SAME hand. 9 Beret seated, hand drops as she rotates back to her first turned-away pose. Do not add a second hat or a brimmed hat or swap hands. Camera and background completely still, enough room for the whole hand and flying hat.
